## **Do you meet the profile required criteria?**

- University Degree
- Experience of logistics management with an INGO in the Philippines
- Knowledge of donor guidelines and procedures
- Ability to work strategically
- Understanding of safety and security context in the Philippines
- Good analytical skills
- At least 3 years previous hand on logistic management experience in emergency response and development programs with a NGO in the Philippines
- At least 3 years of experience in safety and security management
- Experience working with and supporting people remotely
- Experience overseeing IT services, communications systems and IT support functions is desirable
- English is a must
- MS Office very strong command
- Advanced level of Excel
- Valuable prior experience in issues related to the promotion of gender equality or personal commitment to gender equality

## **Our remuneration package:**

- Compensation: based on Action Against Hunger grid
- Benefits: health insurance, accident and life insurance, leave entitlement, government-mandated benefits
- Fixed-term Employment

**Action against Hunger is committed to preventing any type of unwanted behaviour at work such as but not limited to sexual harassment, sexual exploitation and abuse, lack of integrity and/or financial misconduct; We expects all staff and volunteers to share this commitment through endorsing our code of conduct and other related policies and only those who share our values and code of conduct will be recruited to work for us.**

title: Finance Assistant
source: Deutsche Gesellschaft für Internationale Zusammenarbeit (GIZ) GmbH
body:
**Job description**

GIZ has been operating in Syria since 1976. It has thus established valuable contacts in civil society and garnered experience that is now crucial for supporting the country. From 2013 onwards, it worked without government involvement with the assistance of local non-governmental organizations. Despite the difficult conditions, GIZ has consistently contributed to improving people’s living conditions.

In view of the developments since December 2024, which have led Syria into a decisive phase of transformation, GIZ reopens its Country Office in Damascus in 2026. It is currently implementing 14 projects on behalf of the German Federal Ministry for Economic Cooperation and Development (BMZ) and the Federal Foreign Office (FFO), with co-financing from the European Union and other donors. From 2026, the portfolio is planned to be expanded by several new projects.

**Your tasks**

- Receive, register, and process invoices and payment requests in accordance with GIZ rules and regulations, ensuring completeness and accuracy of supporting documentation.
- Check invoices, payment requests, and related documents for required approvals, correct calculations, and compliance with established financial procedures, and follow up on missing information.
- Prepare payment documentation, payment vouchers, and supporting documents for cash and bank transactions, and submit them for further verification and approval.
- Support the processing of travel expense settlements, including checking travel-related documents, flight tickets, accommodation invoices, and other supporting documents in line with GIZ travel regulations.
- Regularly follow up on outstanding invoices, advances, receivables, payables, and pending settlements, and maintain updated records for the Finance Unit.
- Support cash and bank management activities, including preparing cash withdrawal requests, maintaining transaction records, and assisting with cash counts and bank reconciliations.
- Assist in preparing and entering financial data into GIZ accounting systems, ensuring accurate documentation and proper filing of transactions.
- Support the Head of Finance and other Finance Unit colleagues in daily financial operations and perform additional finance-related tasks as assigned by the line manager.

**Your profile (required qualifications, competencies and experience)**

- University degree or diploma in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.
- At least two years of relevant professional experience in accounting or financial administration, including checking invoices and supporting documents and maintaining financial records.
- Practical knowledge of basic bookkeeping and the documentation required for financial transactions.
- Ability to use Microsoft Excel to maintain transaction lists, sort and filter data, apply basic formulas and identify discrepancies between financial records.
- Ability to organise assigned tasks, meet deadlines and follow up on missing documents or information.
- Ability to handle financial information accurately and confidentially and to report discrepancies promptly.
- Willingness to learn and apply GIZ financial procedures and systems.
- Fluency in Arabic and good working knowledge of English are required. G

Desirable experience

- Experience using accounting software or an ERP system.
- Experience with travel expense settlements, advance monitoring, cash counts or bank reconciliations.
- Experience working with GIZ, another international organisation or an organisation with documented financial procedures and approval workflows.
- Knowledge of German is an advantage.

title: Researcher / Analyst
source: Deutsche Gesellschaft für Internationale Zusammenarbeit (GIZ) GmbH
body:
**Job description**

GIZ has been operating in Syria since 1976. It has thus established valuable contacts in civil society and garnered experience that is now crucial for supporting the country. From 2013 onwards, it worked without government involvement with the assistance of local non-governmental organizations. Despite the difficult conditions, GIZ has consistently contributed to improving people’s living conditions.

In view of the developments since December 2024, which have led Syria into a decisive phase of transformation, GIZ reopens its Country Office in Damascus in 2026. It is currently implementing 14 projects on behalf of the German Federal Ministry for Economic Cooperation and Development (BMZ) and the Federal Foreign Office (FFO), with co-financing from the European Union and other donors. From 2026, the portfolio is planned to be expanded by several new projects.

The Analysis and Research Unit supports the Syria portfolio with timely, evidence-based analysis on general context, including economic and social developments. It provides decision-relevant research and analysis to programme teams, senior management and commissioning parties.

The Researcher / Analyst will contribute to this work by combining strong research skills with analytical judgement, local knowledge and the ability to turn complex and sometimes incomplete information into clear and concise analysis.

**Your tasks**

- Monitor and analyse political, security, governance, economic and social developments relevant to GIZ’s work in Syria.
- Conduct focused research in response to questions from programme teams, senior management and commissioning parties.
- Analyse developments at national and sub-national level.
- Identify emerging trends, risks and changes in the operating environment and assess their potential implications for GIZ programmes and partners.
- Triangulate information across Arabic- and English-language open sources, official information.
- Draft concise analytical notes, briefings, situation updates, profiles, stakeholder mappings and other research products.
- Support assessments of institutions, organizations, stakeholders and potential partners where relevant to programme decision-making.
- Conduct key informant interviews and other consultations and contribute to developing and maintaining relevant professional information networks.
- Contribute to political economy, conflict sensitivity, access and operational risk analysis.
- Maintain structured research records, source logs, datasets and other analytical resources used by the team.
- Support the use of digital research and analytical tools, while independently checking underlying sources and analytical outputs.
- Work closely with other analysts to test assumptions, challenge conclusions and improve the quality and consistency of the unit’s analytical products.
- Develop subject-matter or geographic expertise in line with the priorities of the Analysis and Research Unit.

**Your profile (required qualifications, competencies and experience)**

- University degree in political science, international relations, economics, sociology, development studies, law, security studies, journalism or another relevant field.
- Relevant professional experience in research, analysis, journalism, international development, humanitarian affairs, governance, security analysis or a related field.
- Strong knowledge of contemporary Syria, including its political, institutional, socio-economic and security context.
- Demonstrated ability to conduct independent research using multiple sources and to assess the reliability and limitations of available information.
- Strong analytical skills, including the ability to identify patterns, assess competing explanations and explain the significance of developments rather than simply describe them.
- Ability to work with incomplete, and sometimes contradictory information and to communicate uncertainty clearly.
- Strong Arabic-language research skills, including the ability to work across formal and informal Arabic-language sources.
- Strong professional English skills, particularly in written analysis.
- Ability to write clearly, concisely and in a way that is accessible to non-specialist audiences.
- Strong online research, information verification and source assessment skills.
- Experience conducting interviews, consultations or maintaining professional information networks is an advantage.
- Familiarity with spreadsheets, data management, mapping, social-media research, data visualisation or other analytical tools is an advantage.
- Experience working with an international organisation, research institution, think tank, media organisation or consultancy is an advantage.
- Strong judgement, intellectual curiosity and attention to detail.
- Ability to work independently while contributing actively to a collaborative analytical team.
- Ability to work under short deadlines and adapt to changing analytical priorities.

title: Human Resources Administrative Assistant
source: Deutsche Gesellschaft für Internationale Zusammenarbeit (GIZ) GmbH
body:
**Job description**

GIZ has been operating in Syria since 1976. It has thus established valuable contacts in civil society and garnered experience that is now crucial for supporting the country. From 2013 onwards, it worked without government involvement with the assistance of local non-governmental organizations. Despite the difficult conditions, GIZ has consistently contributed to improving people’s living conditions.

In view of the developments since December 2024, which have led Syria into a decisive phase of transformation, GIZ reopens its Country Office in Damascus in 2026. It is currently implementing 14 projects on behalf of the German Federal Ministry for Economic Cooperation and Development (BMZ) and the Federal Foreign Office (FFO), with co-financing from the European Union and other donors. From 2026, the portfolio is planned to be expanded by several new projects.

The HR Unit of GIZ Country Office Syria supports the full employee lifecycle, including recruitment, onboarding, personnel administration and staff development.

**Your tasks**

As HR Administrative Assistant, you support the team with day-to-day administrative tasks, document management and scheduling. Working under the guidance of HR colleagues, you help maintain accurate personnel records, prepare recruitment activities and ensure timely administrative follow-up.

*Personnel files and document management*

- Maintain and organise physical and electronic personnel files in accordance with GIZ filing procedures and confidentiality requirements.
- Scan, copy, label, upload and archive HR documents, ensuring that records are complete, accurate and easy to retrieve by authorised colleagues.
- Check documents, follow up on missing documents or signatures and flag discrepancies to the responsible HR colleague.

*Recruitment and appointment coordination*

- Schedule interviews, written assessments and HR meetings, coordinating availability with candidates, panel members and colleagues.
- Prepare interview documents, candidate information, meeting rooms and online meeting links, and support the practical arrangements for assessments.
- Send invitations, reminders and standard correspondence using approved templates and instructions, and maintain recruitment schedules and tracking lists.
- Printing of GIZ ID and business cards and employment letters

*General HR administration and support*

- Support onboarding and offboarding by preparing document packages, coordinating appointments and following up on administrative checklists.
- Prepare routine HR correspondence and documents using approved templates for review by the responsible HR colleague.
- Enter and update employee information, approved leave records and other administrative data in HR systems and tracking lists, as instructed.
- Collect and organise supporting documents for payroll, insurance and other personnel processes for review and processing by HR colleagues.
- Support the organisation of induction sessions, training activities and staff meetings, including invitations, attendance lists and materials.
- Receive routine administrative enquiries, provide information on submission procedures and refer substantive HR questions to the responsible colleague.
- Perform other administrative and support tasks appropriate to the position, as assigned.

**Your profile (required qualifications, competencies and experience)**

- Bachelor’s degree in human resources, psychology, business administration, public administration or a related field.
- First experience in administrative or office support; experience in HR administration is an advantage.
- Experience in maintaining filing systems, handling documents and coordinating appointments.
- Good working knowledge of MS Office, particularly Word, Excel, Outlook and Teams; familiarity with digital filing systems or HR databases is an advantage.
- Strong organisational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage routine tasks and follow up reliably on deadlines.
- A cooperative, service-oriented approach, clear communication skills and willingness to learn.
- Excellent command of written and spoken English and Arabic.

title: Receiving Supervisor
source: Mission for Essential Drugs and Supplies
body:
Mission for Essential Drugs and Supplies (MEDS) is a faith-based health solutions provider founded by an ecumenical partnership of the Kenya Conference of Catholic Bishops (KCCB) and the Christian Health Association of Kenya (CHAK). The Organization’s core mandate is providing access to quality health products and technologies through Supply Chain, Quality Assurance and Health Systems Strengthening services. MEDS was established in 1986 and serves clients spread throughout Kenya, other regions in Africa and beyond.

The position will report to Warehouse and Logistics Manager and will be responsible for coordinating all inbound operations for both MEDS commercial business and donor-funded projects to ensure accurate, timely processing and efficient management of goods and supplier interactions.

Job Responsibilities

i. Coordinate receipt, verification, and accurate system entry of all commercial and donor-funded consignments to ensure timely receipt and inventory accuracy  
ii. Supervise receiving and inbound warehouse operations, ensuring efficient coordination of workflows, effective utilization of resources, and compliance with established warehouse procedures  
iii. Coordinate the verification and processing of suppliers' invoices to facilitate stock inspection, acceptance, and storage  
iv. Coordinate the processing of inbound returns to ensure accurate inventory reconciliation and timely resolution of customer complaints  
v. Maintain accurate records of received goods to ensure inventory integrity, traceability, and accountability  
vi. Assess operational workload and recommend temporary staffing requirements for donor-funded and other special projects to support operational needs  
vii. Supervise, coach, and develop receiving staff, including coordinating leave schedules to ensure continuous operations and adequate staffing

x. Monitor supplier deliveries and coordinate receiving activities to ensure efficient and timely inbound operations  
xi. Verify received goods against purchase orders and delivery documentation, including quantities, batch numbers, expiry dates, and product specifications, to ensure accuracy and compliance  
xii. Coordinate the physical and system-based release of received goods for quality inspection in accordance with established warehouse procedures  
xiii. Coordinate the processing of inbound returns to facilitate inventory reconciliation and the resolution of customer complaints  
xiv. Maintain accurate receiving records to support inventory integrity, traceability, and accountability

Qualifications  
i. Bachelor’s Degree in Supply Chain Management/ Business management/ Business Administration/Operations Management/Commerce or related field  
ii. Diploma in Pharmacy  
iii. Minimum five (5) years of relevant experience in a busy Pharmaceutical or fast-moving consumer goods (FMCG) Warehouse, three (3) of which should be in a supervisory role

Data Analysis; MS Office Suite Proficiency; use of ERP system  
v. Behavioural competencies: Supervisory Skills; Communication skills; Problem solving skills; Analytical skills; high level of integrity; keen to details

title: Solidarity for Change and Voice (S4CV) Programme Support Officer
body:
**Context of Role**

IPPF operates in a complex, global, and fast-paced environment, requiring strong administrative coordination and logistical support to enable teams to deliver effectively.

This role supports the operational functioning of global initiatives by coordinating information, schedules, documentation, meetings and finance, and other reporting requirements. Strong administrative systems and clear communication are essential to supporting collaboration across the division.

**Role Purpose**

This is an entry-level coordination and administration role that provides day-to-day administrative, program planning and logistics support to S4CV global teams.

The role ensures smooth team operations, accurate tracking of programme and project activities, finances, effective coordination of meetings, projects and events, and timely flow of information across the Secretariat.

**Deliverables**

- Coordinate and support day-to-day administrative and logistical activities for global and regional initiatives, ensuring plans, schedules and documentation are accurate and up to date.
- Utilise tools to arrange consultancies (Kofax), finance updates, invoicing (Netsuite) and other team administration activities to ensure alignment to secretariat reporting and admin timelines and expectations.
- Organise and support meetings, workshops and events, including scheduling, agendas, minutes, follow-up actions and logistical arrangements (virtual and in-person).
- Maintain centralised records, trackers and filing systems for plans, activities, risks, actions and key documents.
- Act as a first point of contact for administrative queries from internal teams and Member Associations, ensuring timely information flow.
- Support project teams with planning timelines, action tracking and progress updates, escalating issues where appropriate.
- Coordinate information requests and contributions across teams, consolidating inputs into summaries or updates (non-analytical).
- Support compliance with organisational processes by ensuring required documentation is prepared, submitted and stored correctly.
- Support administration of projects including due diligence, contracting, payment processing, record-keeping, compliance monitoring, and grant closure
- Maintain shared calendars, contact lists, distribution lists and internal communication channels.
- Support and enable a safe environment, adhering to safeguarding reporting and monitoring requirements of the role.
- Gather and collate information, ensuring that established work plans and activities are monitored and delivered consistently in accordance with requirements, standards and practice, escalating where necessary to line management to highlight potential issues.
- Support in tracking/reporting platforms; and at the instruction of S4CV leaders, maintain guidance and resource tools which support programme planning, implementation, changes and advancement.

**Desirable Skills**

- Numerate with proven quantitative and qualitative data management skills.
- Strong administrative, organisational and coordination skills, with attention to detail.
- Experience supporting teams through scheduling, documentation, meeting coordination and action tracking.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools, particularly Excel (basic tracking), Word, Outlook and Teams.
- Proficiency or willingness to master other tools particularly NetSuite, Kofax
- Ability to manage multiple tasks, priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to liaise confidently with diverse, multicultural and multilingual stakeholders.
- Experience working across teams and time zones is desirable.
- Comfortable handling confidential and sensitive information appropriately.

**Your, Ethos:**

- Demonstrate an understanding of and commitment to safeguarding in a local and international context.
- Demonstrates ability and willingness to work in a diverse, multicultural, multilingual and intergenerational environment that is anti-racist and respectful of others.
- An intersectional (pro) feminist passionate about sexual reproductive health care rights + justice, including safe abortion.
- Supportive of people’s rights regardless of sexuality or gender identity/expression and supportive of workers’ rights and access to health care in sex work.

title: Wash Officer - Venezuela
body:
Location: Caracas/La Guaira

Duration: Short-term contract

Reporting to: WASH Coordinator

Closing date: 3 November 2026

**Job purpose**

The WASH Officer will serve as the primary technical and operational liaison to ensure the smooth implementation of water, sanitation and hygiene interventions following the June 2026 earthquakes.

Under the supervision of the WASH Coordinator, the WASH Officer will lead the execution of technical assessments, the rehabilitation of community and health infrastructure, and hygiene promotion. They will also ensure effective coordination with local stakeholders and adherence to quality standards and reporting deadlines for programme funders.

**The main responsibilities of this post include:**

**1. Technical implementation and infrastructure**

- Lead the data collection and needs assessments for WASH in the intervention areas to identify gaps in water and sanitation services.
- To technically supervise the construction, rehabilitation or adaptation activities of sanitation structures and community water infrastructure.
- Lead the evaluation of essential equipment and coordinate the implementation of handwashing stations at scale in priority clinics in La Guaira.
- Ensure that all technical interventions comply with Sphere standards and WASH methodologies in emergencies.

**2. Supervision of community activities and promotion of hygiene**

- Carry out follow-up visits and continuous monitoring of the implementation sites to verify the development of activities and ensure that the project objectives are achieved.
- Develop, organise and support training processes, guiding communities and local teams on the use, maintenance and good practices of water and sanitation.
- Support the logistics of community activities, maintaining fluid and assertive communication with community leaders, institutions and operational partners to facilitate access and implementation.
- Proactively identify risks, problems, or delays in the execution of field activities and propose timely corrective actions.

**3. Logistics and operational coordination**

- Support the monitoring of field budgets and the tracking of requests for the acquisition of critical WASH supplies.
- Oversee community distribution and inventory control of water purification tablets and hygiene kits, ensuring that they conform to current budgetary adjustments.
- Collaborate with the logistics team to ensure that transport contracts, warehouse space rentals and material branding are aligned with distribution schedules\*.\*

**4. Monitoring, data and reports**

- Prepare periodic field reports, records, attendance lists, minutes and other qualitative-quantitative verification means related to the activities carried out.
- Consolidate and validate the information collected in the field using mobile information collection tools (e.g., Kobo Collect).
- Ensure the timely delivery of technical draft progress reports to strictly comply with the cut-off dates and reporting deadlines of the various donors.

**5. Protection and safeguarding**

- Ensure that all procedures developed in the field protect and seek dignified treatment towards programme participants and partners.
- To act with the highest level of honesty and integrity in the detection, care or referral of any possible case of mistreatment, abuse or sexual exploitation.
- Promote a protective culture, guaranteeing the privacy and strict confidentiality of the organisation's data, facts and procedures.

**5. Others**

1. Any other function that may be assigned by the WASH Coordinator.

The MENTOR Initiative works in a constantly changing humanitarian environment - reasonable duties that do not fit the above job description but help to further the overall aims and goals of the programme may be requested.

**Role requirements**

- Have the legal right to live and work in Venezuela.
- University degree in environmental health, sanitation, civil or environmental engineering, public health or related fields (Essential)[\[SB1\]](https://reliefweb.int/#_msocom_1) .
- Minimum two years of verifiable experience in supervisory roles, monitoring and implementation of Water, Sanitation and Hygiene (WASH) activities in Venezuela (Essential).
- Previous experience in community activities and hygiene promotion.
- Practical knowledge of Sphere and WASH standards in emergencies and methodologies such as Community Led-Total Sanitation (Desirable).
- Basic or intermediate proficiency in Office 365 and mobile data collection tools.
- Excellent skills in developing qualitative and quantitative reports, and good communication skills (oral and written).
- Proactive, empathic, strong service orientation and ability to work in a team.
- Experience working with NGOs in emergency contexts (Desirable).

The MENTOR Initiative is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity in the organisation. We ensure the constant non-discrimination throughout the recruitment process.

The MENTOR Initiative is committed to promoting diversity and gender equality and strongly encourages candidates from under-represented backgrounds to apply.

The MENTOR Initiative applies a zero-tolerance approach to sexual exploitation, abuse, mistreatment or harassment, and other types of unethical behaviour including fraud.

The MENTOR Initiative will contact previous employers of applicants to determine if they have any history of violating international standards and codes of conduct relating to such matters.

title: Chargé-e des Opérations - SENEGAL (JPO)
body:
**Entrée en fonction :** 1.12.26

**Durée :** 6 mois

**Lieu :** Dakar, Sénégal

**Statut :** non accompagné

Terre des hommes ne fixe pas de date de clôture pour ce poste ; le recrutement se poursuit jusqu'à ce que le poste soit pourvu.

**Tdh :**

La Fondation Terre des hommes (Tdh), dont le siège est à Lausanne et le bureau à Zurich, est la plus grande organisation suisse de défense des droits de l'enfant avec plus de 2000 collaborateurs et collaboratrices dans le monde. Nous nous engageons aux côtés des enfants pour garantir leurs droits, protéger leur vie et améliorer leur bien-être. Nous y parvenons grâce à nos programmes innovants dans les domaines de la santé, de la migration et de l'accès à la justice, conçus pour avoir un impact positif et durable.

**Contexte :**

Terre des hommes Lausanne (Tdh), fondée en 1960, est la plus grande organisation suisse de défense des droits de l'enfant. Tdh se consacre à apporter des changements significatifs et durables dans la vie des enfants et des jeunes, en particulier ceux et celles qui sont le plus en danger. Tdh est active dans une trentaine de pays, dans des contextes humanitaires et de développement.

En Afrique subsaharienne, Tdh intervient directement dans 8 pays (Burkina Faso, Burundi, Guinée-Conakry, Kenya Mali, Mauritanie, Nigeria et Sénégal,) et via des partenariats dans 6 autres pays (Benin, Cameroun, Madagascar, Niger, Togo et Ouganda).

Dans le cadre de la décentralisation de son modèle d'organisation, Tdh à ouvert un bureau régional à Dakar au Sénégal pour lequel un poste de Chargé.e des Opérations est ouvert.

**Responsabilités :**

Sous la supervision de la Conseillère Régionale en recherche de fonds, le.la Chargé.e des Opérations appuie le bureau régional et les équipes pays dans la mise en œuvre des activités liées aux subventions et à la collecte de fonds dans la région Afrique.

Ce poste contribue aux processus relatifs aux subventions et à la collecte de fonds — du suivi des opportunités à l'élaboration des propositions et au reporting auprès des bailleurs — tout en soutenant les efforts en matière d'engagement des bailleurs et de partenariats à l'échelle de la région.

Grant Acquisition Process

- Contribue à l'identification et au suivi des opportunités de financement pertinentes pour les programmes de Tdh dans la région Afrique.
- Appuie le développement et la soumission de propositions de projet régionales, multipays et pays : appui ou coordination du processus d’écriture, respect des procédures bailleurs, développement de plans d’action, écriture, traduction, enregistrement sur les plateformes de soumission.
- Contribue au contrôle qualité et à la finalisation des rapports pour des financements institutionnels tout en s’assurant de la soumission en temps voulu (suivi du calendrier et des échéances, relances lorsque nécessaire auprès des contributeurs, consolidation des données, etc.), conformément aux exigences contractuelles et aux normes de Tdh.
- Assure le suivi des besoins en cofinancement avec la CR Finance, appui l'élaboration de propositions et rapports de projets à destination de fondations en coordination avec le secteur philanthropie.
- Veille à ce que les informations relatives aux subventions et aux financements dans Engage360 et les GFU pays et région (système interne de Tdh) soient exactes et régulièrement mises à jour, et assure le suivi auprès des équipes concernées pour garantir l'exhaustivité des données. En cas d’absence de Chargé.e de Grant dans une délégation, assure directement la mise à jour des données pour le pays concerné.
- Appuie le développement des contrats de partenariats opérationnels (contenu, signature, archivage, etc.).
- Contribue à l’analyse des réponses aux demandes de financements institutionnels et philanthropiques.
- S’assure de la collecte et de l’archivage des documents institutionnels nécessaires à la signature des contrats en collaboration avec le siège, la région, les délégations et les partenaires.

Communication

- Appuie la relation avec les bailleurs de fonds et les partenaires, y compris la préparation de supports de recherche de fonds (ex. : témoignages, récits de réussite).
- Appuie le rapportage annuel à travers la vérification et la consolidation des données et informations projets, en coordination avec les équipes PREX, Q&A et Grants, ainsi qu’avec les autres parties prenantes concernées aux niveaux des délégations et de la région.
- Contribue à la communication interne liée aux projets (newsletter mensuelle, supports spécifiques, etc.) et consolide les éléments proposés par les délégations et la région, en veillant à la cohérence, à l’exactitude et à la qualité des informations rapportées.

*La description complète du poste sera communiquée aux candidats sélectionnés pour lancer le processus de recrutement.*

**Profil recherché**

**Formation :**

Etude supérieure (Master ou autre diplôme équivalant en relations internationales, développement ou autre domaine pertinent)

**Langues :**

Excellentes compétences linguistiques en Français et Anglais.

**Compétences :**

- Bonne compréhension de la gestion du cycle de projet dans les environnements de développement, d'urgence et de crises prolongées, notamment en Afrique
- Bonne compréhension du processus d’aquisition de financements.

**IT :** Maitrise des outils et applications usuels (Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.)

**Conditions :**

Contrat suisse

Salaire mensuel brut CHF 2450- x13,36 mois

Assurances : maladie, accident, rapatriement

Congés annuels : 25 jours/an

Vols aller-retour vers le lieu d'affectation

**Code Global de Conduite et Politiques Ethiques de Tdh :**

S'engage à promouvoir et à respecter le Code de Conduite Global, à rapporter systématiquement toute violation du Code à travers les mécanismes formels de rapport de Tdh et à traiter toute violation des procédures et des processus de manière appropriée.

Sensibilise la Fondation aux risques de non-respect des politiques, de violence et d'abus, et aux droits qui en découlent, à l'égard des enfants, des membres de la communauté et de nos propres employé.e.s.

S'engage à respecter les principales politiques et directives éthiques, notamment la politique de sauvegarde, la politique de lutte contre la fraude et la corruption, la politique relative aux conflits d'intérêts et d'autres politiques liées à la prévention du financement du terrorisme et des activités criminelles, ainsi qu’au comportement sur le lieu de travail.

S'engage à mettre en pratique les valeurs et les principes en adoptant un comportement exemplaire, en parfaite adéquation avec le code de conduite, et en respectant toujours les procédures et les processus établis.

S'engage à développer une culture de management conforme et éclairée au sein de l'organisation et dans notre travail avec les enfants et les communautés dans lesquelles nous opérons.

title: Digital Fundraising and Communications Officer
source: Medecins du Monde - Turkey / Dunya Doktorlari Dernegi
body:
**Dünya Doktorları Dernegi (DDD)** is a Turkish based humanitarian non-governmental organisation that facilitates access to healthcare for populations affected by armed conflict, violence, natural disasters, disease, famine, poverty and exclusion.

Our organization collaborates with partners and key stakeholders to implement projects that facilitate access to primary and secondary-level healthcare services to respond to the medical needs of displaced population.

DDD is the 16th member of the Doctors of the World International Network that is committed to meeting the health needs of vulnerable people globally.

Please visit [www.dunyadoktorlari.org.tr](http://www.dunyadoktorlari.org.tr) to learn more.

**Hierarchical & Functional links**

Based in Istanbul, Digital Fundraising and Communications Officer will be directly supervised by the Deputy Operations Director

**Status**:Fixed-term contract

**Expected Starting Date:** 23/11/2026

**EXPECTED PROFILE**

**Knowledge & Qualification**

Bachelor's degree in Communications, Marketing, Digital Marketing, Fundraising, Business Administration, Journalism, International Relations, or a related field.

**Experience**

· Minimum 3 years of professional experience in digital fundraising, digital marketing, communications, e-commerce, or donor acquisition.

· Demonstrated experience managing websites, social media platforms, and digital engagement tools.

· Experience developing content for fundraising, marketing, or public engagement purposes.

· Experience using digital performance data and audience insights to improve results.

· Experience working with email marketing, newsletters, CRM systems, SMS outreach tools, or online fundraising platforms is an asset.

· Experience within the non-profit, humanitarian, or development sector is desirable

**Languages**

· Excellent written and spoken Turkish. · Arabic and/or English are considered strong assets.

**IT & Equipment**

· Good proficiency with Microsoft package

**Skills and Qualities required:**

· Proficient in MS Office (Word, Excel, Outlook);

· Strong attention to detail, ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously and effective time management;

· Capacity to handle confidential and sensitive information with a high degree of professional integrity;

· Good interpersonal and communication skills; ability to work effectively in a multicultural team environment;

· Commitment to DDD Code of Conduct and humanitarian principles;

**Essential Duties**

· Develop and implement DDD's digital acquisition strategy.

· Increase fundraising revenue through the acquisition and retention of new donors and supporters via digital channels.

· Expand DDD's digital reach, donor base, and supporter engagement.

· Identify and test innovative approaches, tools, and channels that contribute to donor and revenue growth.

· Lead content development for DDD digital channels.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Main Responsibilities**

**Function details**

**Digital Fundraising and Donor Acquisition**

· Contribute to the development and implementation of DDD's individual giving and digital fundraising strategies.

· Generate new donor leads and convert supporters into donors through digital engagement activities.

· Design and optimize donor acquisition offers, donation journeys, and online giving experiences.

· Monitor fundraising performance and make recommendations to improve results based on data and audience insights.

· Maintain an understanding of emerging digital fundraising trends, tools, and best practices.

**Website and Digital Platforms**

· Manage and develop DDD's website as a key fundraising and donor engagement platform.

· Maintain and update website content, donation pages, and landing pages.

· Develop new online fundraising initiatives and giving opportunities through DDD's digital platforms.

· Optimize website user experience.

· Coordinate with external providers and developers as required.

**Communications and Content Development**

· Develop content that supports donor acquisition, fundraising, visibility, and supporter engagement objectives.

· Produce and coordinate written, graphic, photographic, and video content for digital and print publications.

· Maintain an annual calendar of international and health-related days relevant to DDD's mission and develop timely content and fundraising hooks around them in coordination with program teams.

· Work with program teams to collect field stories, photos, videos, and impact data for donor communications, newsletters, promotional materials, and fundraising content.

· Ensure compliance with DDD branding, messaging, and visibility guidelines, including consent and data protection.

· Manage the archiving and structuring of the DDD communications Sharepoint.

**Social Media and Digital Visibility**

· Manage DDD's social media presence, including Instagram, LinkedIn, X, YouTube, Facebook, and other relevant platforms for newsletters and SMS campaigns.

· Develop and implement visibility initiatives that increase audience reach and supporter engagement.

· Create, schedule, publish, and monitor content across digital channels, and recommend improvements.

**Monitoring and Reporting**

· Track and report on donor acquisition, fundraising revenue, audience growth, website performance, and digital engagement.

· Analyse fundraising and digital performance data to support decision-making and continuous improvement.

· Produce regular reports and recommendations for management.

**Reporting**

· Provide regular reporting on your activities to your Line-Manager upon his/her solicitation;

· Provide your line-manager with a Handover Report at the end of your contract

**Compliance & Ethics**  
Promote and encourage a culture of compliance and ethics throughout Dünya Doktorları Derneği. As applicable to the position, maintains a clear understanding of Dünya Doktorları Derneği and donor compliance and ethics standards and adheres to those standards. Conducts work with the highest level of integrity. Communicates these values to staff and to partners and requires them to adhere to these values.

**Prevention of Sexual Exploitation and Abuse**  
Actively promote PSEA (Prevention of Sexual Exploitation and Abuse) standards within Dünya Doktorları Derneği and amongst beneficiaries served by Dünya Doktorları Derneği.

**NB:** Considering the purpose and values of the organisation, DDD requests to its employee complete flexibility in term of duties and commitment, as their job description and job title can be adjusted throughout the year according to needs and priorities.

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis.Please be advised that female candidates are highly encouraged.

*Dünya Doktorları Derneği is an equal opportunity employer whereby we ensure all hiring and employment decisions, and operates all programs, services, and functions without the practices that discriminate against any person employed or seeking employment based on race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national or ethnic origin, age, marital status, disability, genetic information or any other status or characteristic protected under applicable law.*

**How to Apply:**

Please apply with your **CV and motivation letter in ENGLISH** through our website

**Closure Date: 06.11.2026**

Due to the urgency to fill this post, DDD reserves the right to review the CVs on a rolling basis and selected candidates may be interviewed prior to the closing dates listed, therefore early applications are encouraged.  
DDD is not in a position to respond to every applicant individually due to the anticipated high number of applications.  
Please note that only short-listed candidates will be contacted for the first interview.

Any offer made to the candidate in relation to this vacancy notice is subject to funding confirmation.

**General Information**  
DDD retains the discretion to re-advertise the vacancy, to cancel the recruitment, to offer a contract with a modified job description or for a different duration, or to offer a contract at a lower grade.

\---------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Dünya Doktorları Derneği (DDD)\*, silahlı çatışma, şiddet, doğal afetler, salgın hastalıklar, kıtlık, yoksulluk ve dışlanmadan etkilenen toplulukların sağlık hizmetlerine erişimini kolaylaştıran, Türkiye merkezli insani yardım amaçlı bir sivil toplum kuruluşudur.**

Kuruluşumuz, yerinden edilmiş nüfusun tıbbi ihtiyaçlarına yanıt vermek amacıyla birinci ve ikinci basamak sağlık hizmetlerine erişimi kolaylaştıran projeleri hayata geçirmek için ortaklar ve kilit paydaşlarla iş birliği yapmaktadır.

DDD, dünya genelinde kırılgan durumdaki kişilerin sağlık ihtiyaçlarını karşılamaya kendini adamış olan Dünya Doktorları Derneği Uluslararası Ağı'nın 16. üyesidir.

Daha fazla bilgi için lütfen [www.dunyadoktorlari.org.tr](http://www.dunyadoktorlari.org.tr) adresini ziyaret edin.

**Hiyerarşik ve Fonksiyonel Bağlantılar**

İstanbul merkezli olarak çalışacak Dijital Bağış Toplama ve İletişim Sorumlusu, doğrudan Operasyon Direktör Yardımcısı'na bağlı olacaktır.

**Statü:** Belirli süreli sözleşme

**Beklenen Başlangıç Tarihi**: 23/11/2026

**ARANAN PROFİL**

**Bilgi ve Nitelikler**

İletişim, Pazarlama, Dijital Pazarlama, Bağış Toplama, İşletme, Gazetecilik, Uluslararası İlişkiler veya ilgili bir alanda lisans derecesi.

**Deneyim**

· Dijital bağış toplama, dijital pazarlama, iletişim, e-ticaret veya bağışçı kazanımı alanlarında en az 3 yıllık profesyonel deneyim

· Web siteleri, sosyal medya platformları ve dijital etkileşim araçlarının yönetiminde kanıtlanmış deneyim.

· Bağış toplama, pazarlama veya kamuoyu katılımı amaçlı içerik geliştirme deneyimi.

· Sonuçları iyileştirmek için dijital performans verilerini ve kitle içgörülerini kullanma deneyimi.,

· E-posta pazarlaması, bültenler, CRM sistemleri, SMS iletişim araçları veya çevrim içi bağış platformlarıyla çalışma deneyimi tercih sebebidir.

· Kâr amacı gütmeyen, insani yardım veya kalkınma sektöründe deneyim arzu edilir.

**Diller**

· Mükemmel düzeyde yazılı ve sözlü Türkçe.

· Arapça ve/veya İngilizce güçlü bir avantaj olarak değerlendirilecektir.

**IT ve Ekipman**

· Microsoft paket programlarında iyi düzeyde yetkinlik.

**Beceri ve Nitelikler**

· MS Office (Word, Excel, Outlook) kullanımında yetkinlik;

· Detaylara güçlü dikkat, birden fazla görevi aynı anda yürütebilme ve etkili zaman yönetimi;

· Gizli ve hassas bilgileri yüksek düzeyde mesleki dürüstlükle ele alabilme;

· İyi kişilerarası ilişkiler ve iletişim becerileri; çok kültürlü bir ekip ortamında etkili çalışabilme;

· DDD Davranış Kuralları'na ve insani yardım ilkelerine bağlılık.

**Temel Görevler**

· DDD’nin dijital bağışçı kazanım stratejisini geliştirmek ve uygulamak.

· Dijital kanallar üzerinden yeni bağışçı ve destekçileri kazanıpbağlılıklarını sürdürerek bağış gelirlerini artırmak.

· DDD’nin dijital erişimini ve bağışçı tabanını genişletmek, destekçi etkileşimini arttırmak.

· Bağışçı sayısını ve geliri artırmaya katkıda bulunacak yenilikçi yaklaşım, araç ve kanalları belirlemek ve denemek.

· DDD’nin dijital kanallarına yönelikiçerik üretimini yürütmek..

**SORUMLULUKLAR**

**Dijital Bağış Toplama ve Bağışçı Kazanımı**

· DDD'nin bireysel bağış ve dijital bağış toplama stratejilerinin geliştirilmesine ve uygulanmasına katkıda bulunmak.

· Dijital etkileşim faaliyetleriyle yeni bağışçı adayları oluşturmak ve destekçileri bağışçıya dönüştürmek.

· Bağışçı kazanım tekliflerini, bağış süreçlerini ve çevrim içi bağış deneyimlerini tasarlamak ve optimize etmek.

· Bağış toplama performansını izlemek ve veri ile kitle içgörülerine dayanarak sonuçları iyileştirmeye yönelik öneriler sunmak.

· Dijital bağış toplamadaki yeni eğilimleri, araçları ve en iyi uygulamaları takip etmek.

\***Web Sitesi ve Dijital Platformlar\***

· DDD'nin web sitesini temel bir bağış toplama ve bağışçı etkileşimi platformu olarak yönetmek ve geliştirmek.

· Web sitesi içeriklerini, bağış sayfalarını ve açılış sayfalarını güncel tutmak.

· DDD'nin dijital platformları aracılığıyla yeni çevrim içi bağış girişimleri ve bağış fırsatları geliştirmek.

· Web sitesi kullanıcı deneyimini optimize etmek.

· Gerektiğinde dış hizmet sağlayıcılar ve yazılım geliştiricilerle koordinasyon sağlamak.

**İletişim ve İçerik Geliştirme**

· Bağışçı kazanımı, bağış toplama, görünürlük ve destekçi etkileşimi hedeflerini destekleyen içerikler geliştirmek.

· Dijital ve basılı yayınlar için yazılı, grafik, fotoğraf ve video içerikleri üretmek ve koordine etmek.

· DDD'nin misyonuyla ilgili uluslararası ve sağlıkla ilgili özel günlerin yıllık takvimini tutmak; program ekipleriyle koordineli olarak bu günlere yönelik zamanında içerikler ve bağış toplama vesileleri geliştirmek.

· Bağışçı iletişimi, bültenler, tanıtım materyalleri ve bağış toplama içerikleri için program ekipleriyle birlikte sahadan hikâyeler, fotoğraflar, videolar ve etki verileri toplamak.

· Onay ve veri koruma dahil olmak üzere DDD'nin marka, mesaj ve görünürlük yönergelerine uyumu sağlamak.

· DDD iletişim SharePoint alanının arşivlenmesini ve düzenlenmesini yönetmek.

**Sosyal Medya ve Dijital Görünürlük**

· DDD'nin Instagram, LinkedIn, X, YouTube, Facebook ve bülten ile SMS kampanyaları için diğer ilgili platformlardaki sosyal medya varlığını yönetmek.

· Kitle erişimini ve destekçi etkileşimini artıran görünürlük girişimleri geliştirmek ve uygulamak.

· Dijital kanallarda içerik oluşturmak, planlamak, yayınlamak ve izlemek; iyileştirme önerileri sunmak.

**İzleme ve Raporlama**

· Bağışçı kazanımı, bağış geliri, kitle büyümesi, web sitesi performansı ve dijital etkileşimi takip etmek ve raporlamak.

· Karar alma süreçlerini ve sürekli iyileştirmeyi desteklemek amacıyla bağış toplama ve dijital performans verilerini analiz etmek.

· Yönetim için düzenli raporlar ve öneriler hazırlamak.

**Raporlama**

· Talep edildiğinde faaliyetleriniz hakkında bağlı olduğunuz yöneticiye düzenli raporlama yapmak;

· Sözleşmenizin sonunda yöneticinize bir Devir Teslim Raporu sunmak.

**Uyum ve Etik**

Dünya Doktorları Derneği genelinde uyum ve etik kültürünü teşvik etmek. Pozisyonun gerektirdiği ölçüde, Dünya Doktorları Derneği'nin ve bağışçıların uyum ve etik standartlarını net bir şekilde anlamak ve bu standartlara uymak. İşini en yüksek dürüstlük düzeyinde yürütmek. Bu değerleri personele ve ortaklara aktarmak ve onlardan da bu değerlere uymalarını istemek.

**Cinsel Sömürü ve İstismarın Önlenmesi**

Dünya Doktorları Derneği bünyesinde ve hizmet verilen yararlanıcılar arasında PSEA (Cinsel Sömürü ve İstismarın Önlenmesi) standartlarını aktif olarak teşvik etmek.

**NB**: Kuruluşun amacı ve değerleri göz önünde bulundurularak DDD, çalışanlarından görev ve bağlılık açısından tam esneklik beklemektedir; iş tanımı ve unvan, ihtiyaç ve önceliklere göre yıl içinde değiştirilebilir.

Başvurular geldikçe değerlendirilecektir. Kadın adayların başvurusu özellikle teşvik edilmektedir.

*Dünya Doktorları Derneği, fırsat eşitliğine dayalı bir işverendir. Tüm işe alım ve istihdam kararlarında, ayrıca tüm program, hizmet ve faaliyetlerinde; ırk, renk, din, cinsiyet, cinsel yönelim, cinsiyet kimliği, ulusal veya etnik köken, yaş, medeni durum, engellilik, genetik bilgi ya da yürürlükteki mevzuatla korunan diğer herhangi bir statü veya özellik temelinde, istihdam edilen ya da iş arayan hiç kimseye karşı ayrımcılık yapılmamasını sağlar*.

**Nasıl Başvurabilirim**

Lütfen web sitemiz üzerinden \*İNGİLİZCE\* hazırlanmış özgeçmişiniz ve niyet mektubunuzla başvurunuz.

**Son Başvuru Tarihi**:\* 06.11.2026

Pozisyonun acilen doldurulması gerektiğinden DDD, özgeçmişleri geldikçe değerlendirme hakkını saklı tutar ve seçilen adaylar son başvuru tarihinden önce mülakata çağrılabilir; bu nedenle erken başvuru yapılması önerilir.

Beklenen yüksek başvuru sayısı nedeniyle DDD her adaya ayrı ayrı dönüş yapamayacaktır.

Yalnızca ön elemeyi geçen adaylarla ilk mülakat için iletişime geçilecektir.

Bu ilanla ilgili adaya yapılacak her türlü teklif, finansmanın onaylanmasına bağlıdır.

**Genel Bilgi**

DDD; ilanı yeniden yayınlama, işe alım sürecini iptal etme, değiştirilmiş bir iş tanımıyla veya farklı bir süre için sözleşme teklif etme ya da daha düşük bir kademede sözleşme teklif etme hakkını saklı tutar

title: Call for Proposals – Human Rights Documentation Methodology Development Expert || إعلان تزويد خدمات - خبير/ة تطوير منهجيات توثيق حقوق الإنسان
source: Syrian Center for Media and Freedom of Expression
body:
**About SCM:**

The Syrian Center for Media and Freedom of Expression (SCM), is an independent, non-governmental, and non-profit civil society organization founded in 2004. It works to achieve justice, defend human rights, promote media freedom, support civil society, and encourage active citizenship. SCM has gained extensive experience in combating impunity and strengthening the rule of law.

Since 2011, SCM has held Special Consultative Status with the United Nations Economic and Social Council (ECOSOC). Its work focuses on documenting human rights violations and submitting legal files to hold perpetrators accountable, while strengthening the role of victims and their families, and supporting journalists and human rights defenders, as well as independent media as a tool for building democracy.

## **1. Background**

In the context of Syria’s ongoing transition and the new challenges it presents for the protection of human rights and the rule of law, the Syrian Center for Media and Freedom of Expression (SCM) seeks to strengthen its capacity to monitor, document, and analyse human rights violations occurring during this period. To this end, SCM aims to develop an updated and comprehensive documentation and verification methodology grounded in relevant international standards and responsive to the nature of violations and the actors involved in the current context.

While continuing to document violations related to deprivation of liberty, including arbitrary detention, enforced disappearance, torture and ill-treatment, as well as other serious human rights violations and international crimes committed during the conflict, SCM will place particular emphasis during the transitional period on monitoring and documenting violations of legal and procedural safeguards relating to deprivation of liberty; violations of the right to a fair trial; abuses in the exercise of administrative and executive powers that constitute human rights violations; discrimination on prohibited grounds, including violations based on religious or ethnic affiliation; and violations of the right to equality and non-discrimination in the enjoyment of rights, access to services, and participation in public life. Particular attention will also be given to violations of fundamental rights and freedoms, including the rights to freedom of expression, peaceful assembly, and association, as well as violations targeting human rights defenders, lawyers, and civil society actors.

Documenting this diverse range of violations requires the development of a clear and consistent methodology establishing the principles, standards, and procedures governing documentation and verification processes. It also requires the development of a legal and methodological framework for selected priority violations, setting out the legal definition of each violation, its applicable legal basis, constituent elements and legal requirements, and the information, facts, and evidence necessary for its documentation and verification. This will enhance the quality and consistency of documentation and its suitability for analysis and use in reporting, advocacy, transitional justice, and accountability processes.

Accordingly, the Syrian Center for Media and Freedom of Expression (SCM) seeks to engage a service provider (**Human Rights Documentation Methodology Development Specialist**) to undertake the following tasks:

## **2. Scope of Work**

The selected service provider will be responsible for the following tasks:

- Review SCM’s existing documentation and verification methodologies, tools, and procedures, and assess the needs and challenges associated with documenting human rights violations during the transitional period.
- Work in coordination with SCM’s team to identify documentation priorities for the current phase, including the violations and issues that the updated methodology should address as a matter of priority.
- Develop an updated and comprehensive methodology for documenting and verifying human rights violations, grounded in relevant international standards and established practices. The methodology should define the core principles, standards, and procedures governing the various stages of documentation and verification, in line with the priorities and needs identified in consultation with SCM’s team.
- Develop legal and methodological frameworks for priority violations, including definitions, legal bases, constituent elements, and classification criteria, as well as the facts, indicators, and information required for their documentation and classification, with due consideration given to international human rights law, international humanitarian law, and international criminal law, as applicable.
- Develop a clear framework for classifying violations, incidents, victims, actors, sources, and related information, including the relationships between them, in order to promote consistency in documentation and facilitate information analysis and the identification of patterns and trends.
- Establish clear standards and procedures for information collection and verification, and for assessing source reliability. This should cover testimonies, direct and indirect sources, documents, open-source information, and digital content; the corroboration of information across multiple sources; and the handling of conflicting or incomplete information.

## **3. Expected Deliverables**

The service provider will be expected to deliver the following:

- **An updated and comprehensive human rights documentation and verification methodology** that responds to the documentation priorities and needs identified through consultations with SCM’s team and includes the principles, standards, and practical procedures required for documentation and verification.
- **Legal and methodological frameworks for priority violations**, including a definition of each violation, its legal basis, constituent elements, and classification criteria, together with the facts, indicators, and information required for its documentation and classification.
- **Design and development of specialised documentation forms for each violation**, incorporating the fields, questions, and indicators necessary to collect relevant information and evidence. These forms must be aligned with the developed legal and methodological frameworks and ensure data consistency and compatibility with SCM’s existing documentation system.
- **A unified classification framework** covering violations, incidents, victims, actors, sources, and the relationships between them, to improve documentation consistency and facilitate data analysis and the identification of patterns and trends.
- **Standards and procedures for information verification, source reliability assessment, review, quality assurance, and case validation**, including procedures for handling information obtained from multiple sources and addressing conflicting or incomplete information.
- **Practical recommendations for aligning existing documentation tools, forms, and data management systems** with the newly developed methodology and legal and methodological frameworks.
- **Testing of the methodology and frameworks using a sample of cases**, followed by the necessary revisions in light of the findings and lessons learned from their application.
- **Training for SCM’s team** on applying the methodology, legal and methodological frameworks, and the developed documentation and verification standards and procedures, together with technical support during the initial implementation phase.

## **4. Required Qualifications and Experience**

Applicants should meet the following requirements:

- A university degree in law, human rights, or a related field. A relevant postgraduate qualification is preferred.
- At least five years of professional experience in monitoring, documenting, and verifying human rights violations, including demonstrable experience in developing or reviewing documentation methodologies and tools.
- Demonstrable experience in developing legal and methodological frameworks for documenting human rights violations, including defining and classifying violations, identifying their constituent elements and criteria, and determining the information required for their documentation.
- Advanced knowledge of international human rights law and the ability to translate legal standards into practical definitions, criteria, and indicators applicable to monitoring and documentation work, together with sound knowledge of international humanitarian law and international criminal law.
- Practical experience in methodologies for collecting and verifying information and testimonies, including conducting interviews with victims, survivors, and witnesses.
- Experience in assessing source reliability, verifying information, and corroborating information from multiple sources. Experience in open-source research and digital content verification is an asset.
- Good knowledge of the principles and standards relating to informed consent, the principle of *do no harm*, confidentiality, data protection, and the safety and security of victims, witnesses, and sources.
- Experience in developing documentation tools and forms, review procedures, and quality assurance mechanisms, as well as familiarity with human rights documentation data management systems.
- Experience in preparing methodological guides and standard operating procedures (SOPs), and in delivering training and capacity-building for monitoring and documentation teams.
- Previous experience working with human rights organisations or civil society organisations. Experience in transitional contexts is preferred.
- Previous experience in the Syrian context or comparable contexts will be considered an asset.

## **5. Required Application Documents**

Interested service providers must submit the following documents:

- **Curriculum vitae (CV).**
- **A brief technical proposal** outlining the applicant’s understanding of the assignment, proposed methodology, work plan, and proposed timeline.
- **A financial proposal** specifying the total cost of the assignment and including the validity period of the offer, date, and signature.
- **Evidence of experience in similar assignments**, preferably including examples of methodologies, manuals, or tools for documenting human rights violations that the applicant has previously developed or contributed to developing.
- **At least two professional references.**

## **6. Duty Station**

The assignment will be carried out remotely. The service provider must reside in a time zone no more than two to three hours ahead of or behind Paris time, to ensure regular coordination and effective collaboration with SCM’s team.

## **7. Contract Duration and Tentative Start Date**

The assignment will have a **maximum duration of three months**, commencing in **November 2026**, subject to possible adjustments.

## **8. Evaluation Criteria**

Proposals will be evaluated based on the following criteria:

- **Technical expertise, qualifications, and technical proposal – 70%.** This includes experience in developing methodologies for documenting and verifying human rights violations; developing legal and methodological frameworks for violations and identifying their constituent elements and documentation criteria; establishing verification standards and source assessment procedures; developing documentation tools and quality assurance procedures; and the overall quality, relevance, and feasibility of the proposed methodology and work plan.
- **Financial proposal – 30%.**

**لمحة عن جهة العمل**

المركز السوري للإعلام وحرية التعبير هو منظمة مجتمع مدني مستقلة غير حكومية وغير ربحية، تأسست عام 2004، تعمل على تحقيق العدالة، والدفاع عن حقوق الإنسان، وتعزيز حرية الإعلام، ودعم المجتمع المدني، وتشجيع المواطنة الفاعلة. اكتسب المركز خبرة في مكافحة الإفلات من العقاب وتعزيز سيادة القانون.

يتمتع المركز بصفة استشارية خاصة لدى المجلس الاقتصادي والاجتماعي التابع للأمم المتحدة منذ 2011، ويركز عمله على توثيق انتهاكات حقوق الإنسان وتقديم ملفات قضائية لمحاسبة مرتكبيها، مع تعزيز دور الضحايا وأسرهم، ودعم الصحفيين/ات والمدافعين/ات عن حقوق الإنسان، والإعلام المستقل كوسيلة لبناء الديمقراطية.

## **الخلفية**

في ظل السياق الانتقالي الذي تمر به سوريا، وما يطرحه من تحديات جديدة في مجال حماية حقوق الإنسان وسيادة القانون، يعمل المركز السوري للإعلام وحرية التعبير على تعزيز قدرته على رصد وتوثيق وتحليل انتهاكات حقوق الإنسان الواقعة خلال هذه المرحلة، من خلال تطوير منهجية محدثة ومتكاملة للتوثيق والتحقق تستند إلى المعايير الدولية ذات الصلة وتستجيب لطبيعة الانتهاكات والجهات الفاعلة في السياق الحالي.

ومع استمرار عمل المركز في توثيق الانتهاكات المتعلقة بالحرمان من الحرية، بما في ذلك الاعتقال التعسفي والاختفاء القسري والتعذيب وسوء المعاملة، وغيرها من الانتهاكات الجسيمة لحقوق الإنسان والجرائم الدولية المرتكبة خلال النزاع، سيركز المركز بصورة خاصة خلال المرحلة الانتقالية على رصد وتوثيق انتهاكات الضمانات القانونية والإجرائية القانونية المرتبطة بالحرمان من الحرية وانتهاكات الحق في المحاكمة العادلة والتجاوزات في ممارسة السلطات الإدارية والتنفيذية التي تنطوي على انتهاكات لحقوق الإنسان، والتمييز على أسس محظورة، بما في ذلك الانتهاكات القائمة على أساس الانتماء الديني أو الإثني، وانتهاكات الحق في المساواة وعدم التمييز في التمتع بالحقوق والحصول على الخدمات والمشاركة في الحياة العامة، فضلاً عن انتهاكات الحقوق والحريات الأساسية، بما في ذلك الحق في حرية التعبير والتجمع السلمي وتكوين الجمعيات، إضافة إلى الانتهاكات التي تستهدف المدافعين/ات عن حقوق الإنسان والمحامين/ات والعاملين/ات في المجتمع المدني.

ويتطلب توثيق هذا النطاق المتنوع من الانتهاكات تطوير منهجية واضحة ومتسقة تحدد المبادئ والمعايير والإجراءات الناظمة لعملية التوثيق والتحقق، إلى جانب تطوير إطار قانوني ومنهجي لعدد من الانتهاكات ذات الأولوية، يحدد التعريف القانوني لكل انتهاك وأساسه القانوني وأركانه وعناصره القانونية والمعلومات والوقائع والأدلة اللازمة لتوثيقه والتحقق منه، بما يعزز جودة واتساق التوثيق وقابليته للتحليل والاستخدام في التقارير والمناصرة ومسارات العدالة الانتقالية والمساءلة.

وبناءً عليه، يعلن المركز السوري للإعلام وحرية التعبير عن رغبته في التعاقد مع مزود/ة خدمات (أخصائي/ة تطوير منهجيات توثيق حقوق الإنسان) لتنفيذ المهام التالية:

1. **المهام المطلوبة**

- مراجعة منهجيات وأدوات وإجراءات التوثيق والتحقق الحالية المعتمدة لدى المركز، وتقييم الاحتياجات والتحديات المرتبطة بتوثيق انتهاكات حقوق الإنسان خلال المرحلة الانتقالية.
- العمل بالتنسيق مع فريق المركز على تحديد أولويات التوثيق للمرحلة الحالية، بما في ذلك الانتهاكات والقضايا ذات الأولوية التي ينبغي أن تستجيب لها المنهجية المحدثة.
- تطوير منهجية محدثة ومتكاملة لتوثيق انتهاكات حقوق الإنسان والتحقق منها، تستند إلى المعايير والممارسات الدولية ذات الصلة، وتحدد المبادئ والمعايير والإجراءات الأساسية التي تحكم مختلف مراحل عملية التوثيق والتحقق، بما يتناسب مع الأولويات والاحتياجات التي يتم تحديدها بالتنسيق مع فريق المركز.
- تطوير إطار قانوني ومنهجي للانتهاكات ذات الأولوية، يتضمن تعريف الانتهاكات وأسسها القانونية وعناصرها ومعايير توصيفها، وتحديد الوقائع والمؤشرات والمعلومات اللازمة لتوثيقها وتصنيفها، مع مراعاة القانون الدولي لحقوق الإنسان والقانون الدولي الإنساني والقانون الجنائي الدولي بحسب انطباقها.
- تطوير إطار واضح لتصنيف الانتهاكات والحوادث والضحايا والجهات الفاعلة والمصادر والمعلومات ذات الصلة والعلاقات بينها، بما يعزز اتساق عملية التوثيق وإمكانية تحليل المعلومات ورصد الأنماط والاتجاهات.
- تطوير معايير وإجراءات واضحة لجمع المعلومات والتحقق منها وتقييم موثوقية المصادر، بما يشمل الشهادات والمصادر المباشرة وغير المباشرة والوثائق والمصادر المفتوحة والمحتوى الرقمي، وتقاطع المعلومات من مصادر متعددة والتعامل مع المعلومات المتعارضة أو غير المكتملة.

1. ## **المخرجات المتوقعة**

يتوقع من مزود/ة الخدمات تقديم المخرجات التالية:

- منهجية محدثة ومتكاملة لتوثيق انتهاكات حقوق الإنسان والتحقق منها، تستجيب لأولويات واحتياجات التوثيق التي يتم تحديدها بالتنسيق مع فريق المركز، وتتضمن المبادئ والمعايير والإجراءات العملية اللازمة للتوثيق والتحقق.
- إطار قانوني ومنهجي للانتهاكات ذات الأولوية، يتضمن تعريف كل انتهاك وأساسه القانوني وعناصره ومعايير توصيفه، والوقائع والمؤشرات والمعلومات اللازمة لتوثيقه وتصنيفه.
- تصميم وتطوير استمارات توثيق متخصصة لكل انتهاك ، تتضمن الحقول والأسئلة والمؤشرات اللازمة لجمع المعلومات والأدلة ذات الصلة، بما يتوافق مع الإطار القانوني والمنهجي المطور، ويضمن اتساق البيانات وتكاملها مع نظام التوثيق المعتمد لدى المركز.
- إطار موحد للتصنيف يشمل الانتهاكات والحوادث والضحايا والجهات الفاعلة والمصادر والعلاقات بينها، بما يعزز اتساق التوثيق وإمكانية تحليل المعلومات ورصد الأنماط والاتجاهات.
- معايير وإجراءات للتحقق من المعلومات وتقييم موثوقية المصادر والمراجعة وضمان الجودة واعتماد الحالات، بما في ذلك التعامل مع المعلومات الواردة من مصادر متعددة أو المتعارضة أو غير المكتملة.
- توصيات عملية لمواءمة أدوات ونماذج التوثيق وإدارة البيانات الحالية مع المنهجية والإطار القانوني والمنهجي المطورين.
- اختبار المنهجية والإطار المطور على عينة من الحالات، وإجراء التعديلات اللازمة في ضوء نتائج التطبيق.
- تدريب فريق المركز على تطبيق المنهجية والإطار القانوني والمنهجي ومعايير وإجراءات التوثيق والتحقق المطورة، وتقديم الدعم الفني خلال المرحلة الأولى من التطبيق.

1. ## **المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة**

- شهادة جامعية في القانون أو حقوق الإنسان أو مجال ذي صلة؛ ويفضل وجود شهادة دراسات عليا ذات صلة.
- خبرة مهنية لا تقل عن خمس سنوات في رصد وتوثيق انتهاكات حقوق الإنسان والتحقق منها، تتضمن خبرة مثبتة في تطوير أو مراجعة منهجيات وأدوات التوثيق.
- خبرة مثبتة في تطوير الأطر القانونية والمنهجية لتوثيق انتهاكات حقوق الإنسان، بما يشمل تعريف الانتهاكات وتصنيفها وتحديد عناصرها ومعاييرها والمعلومات اللازمة لتوثيقها.
- معرفة متقدمة بالقانون الدولي لحقوق الإنسان والقدرة على ترجمة المعايير القانونية إلى تعريفات ومعايير ومؤشرات عملية قابلة للاستخدام في أعمال الرصد والتوثيق، إلى جانب معرفة جيدة بالقانون الدولي الإنساني والقانون الجنائي الدولي.
- خبرة عملية في منهجيات جمع المعلومات والشهادات والتحقق منها، بما في ذلك إجراء المقابلات مع الضحايا والناجين/ات والشهود.
- خبرة في تقييم موثوقية المصادر والتحقق من المعلومات وتقاطعها من مصادر متعددة، ويفضل وجود خبرة في التحقق من المصادر المفتوحة والمحتوى الرقمي.
- معرفة جيدة بالمبادئ والمعايير المتعلقة بالموافقة المستنيرة وعدم التسبب بالضرر والسرية وحماية البيانات وسلامة الضحايا والشهود والمصادر.
- خبرة في تطوير أدوات ونماذج التوثيق وإجراءات المراجعة وضمان الجودة ومعرفة بأنظمة إدارة بيانات توثيق حقوق الإنسان.
- خبرة في إعداد الأدلة المنهجية والإجراءات التشغيلية القياسية، وفي تدريب وبناء قدرات فرق الرصد والتوثيق.
- خبرة سابقة في العمل مع منظمات حقوق الإنسان أو منظمات المجتمع المدني، ويفضل وجود خبرة في سياقات انتقالية.
- تعتبر الخبرة السابقة في السياق السوري أو في سياقات مشابهة ميزة إضافية.

1. ## **المستندات المطلوبة للتقديم**

- السيرة الذاتية.
- عرض فني مختصر يوضح فهم المتقدم/ة للمهمة، والمنهجية المقترحة لتنفيذها، وخطة العمل والجدول الزمني المقترح.
- عرض مالي يوضح التكلفة الإجمالية للمهمة، ويشمل صلاحية العرض والتاريخ والتوقيع.
- إثبات خبرة في أعمال مماثلة، ويفضل إرفاق أمثلة على منهجيات أو أدلة أو أدوات لتوثيق انتهاكات حقوق الإنسان سبق للمتقدم/ة تطويرها أو المساهمة في تطويرها.
- ما لا يقل عن مرجعين مهنيين.

1. **موقع العمل**

**أونلاين/ عن بعد،** على أن يكون مقر إقامة مزود/ة الخدمة ضمن منطقة زمنية لا يزيد فارق التوقيت فيها عن ساعتين إلى ثلاث ساعات عن توقيت باريس، بما يضمن إمكانية التنسيق والعمل المنتظم مع فريق المركز.

1. **تاريخ العمل**

تبلغ المدة القصوى لتنفيذ المهام **ثلاثة أشهر،** اعتباراً من **تشرين الثاني/نوفمبر 2026،** مع إمكانية تعديل تاريخ البدء.

1. **معيار التقييم**

- الخبرة والمؤهلات الفنية والعرض الفني (70%)، بما يشمل الخبرة في تطوير منهجيات توثيق انتهاكات حقوق الإنسان والتحقق منها، وتطوير الأطر القانونية والمنهجية للانتهاكات وتحديد عناصرها ومعايير توثيقها وتطوير معايير التحقق وتقييم المصادر وأدوات التوثيق وإجراءات ضمان الجودة، إضافة إلى جودة وملاءمة المنهجية وخطة العمل المقترحتين لتنفيذ المهمة.
- العرض المالي (30%).
